resolution.question: Will the Republic of Valdoria's parliamentary transport committee schedule a public hearing on the rail franchise bill within the sixty-day window its rules allow?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that the transport committee scheduled a public hearing on the rail franchise bill before 2026-09-13T09:00:00+02:00 (sixty days from the referral date). Otherwise resolve NO at the hard cutoff 2026-09-30T09:00:00+02:00.
